get.description:
For monitoring, no login needed: is the database reachable, and is the queue
moving? Queued videos piling up with nothing processing means no worker is
running; a growing oldest_queued_seconds means the workers can't keep up.

post.description: OAuth2 compatible token login, get an access token for future requests
Create new user without the need to be logged in.

get.description: Get a specific user by id.
Your videos, newest first, each with its rally count and total rally time.

post.description:
Upload a video (multipart, field `file`). Status starts as `uploaded`.
Limits: MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (413) and MAX_VIDEO_MINUTES (422).

422.description: Video longer than MAX_VIDEO_MINUTES (60), or invalid form

get.description:
Get a video: status (uploaded → queued → processing → done | failed), progress,
size, court, rally count and total rally time.

delete.description:
Delete a video with its rallies and files (yours, or any as a superuser).
Not allowed while it's being processed.

get.description: One frame as JPEG, for marking the court corners.

parameters.name: t

schema.description: Seconds; the very first frame is often black
schema.title: T

parameters.description: Seconds; the very first frame is often black

put.description: Save the 4 court corners (fractions 0-1). Not allowed while queued/processing.

post.description:
Queue the video for rally detection. At most MAX_ACTIVE_VIDEOS_PER_USER of a
user's videos can be queued or processing at once (429 beyond that).

409.description: No court yet, or already queued/processing

429.description: Too many of your videos queued or processing

get.description: Detected rallies, in seconds, ordered by start time.

Shuttle positions for every frame from `start` to `end` (seconds), as fractions
of the frame like the court corners. For drawing the shuttle trail.
At most 600 seconds per request.

404.description: code `trajectory_missing`: the video was analyzed before trajectories were saved (or not analyzed yet); re-analyzing it adds one. A video that doesn't exist gives a plain 404 without a code.

get.description:
A temporary link for playing the video in the browser.

`<video src>` can't send the login header, so use this URL (it carries a
signed token for this one video) instead of putting the login token in a URL.

Stream the video file. Supports Range requests, which the browser's player
needs for seeking.
A video's reels, most recently saved first.

post.description: Create a reel for a video. It belongs to the video's owner.

422.description: Invalid edit list, including checks against the video: a rally_id that isn't one of its rallies, or times past its end. Errors have the usual `loc`, e.g. ["body", "edit", "clips", 2, "trim_end"]

get.description: Get a reel with its edit list.

put.description:
Save a reel: replaces the title and the whole edit list. Send the `updated_at`
you loaded; if the reel was saved since, nothing changes and you get 409.

409.description: code `reel_changed`: saved elsewhere (another tab or device) since you loaded it, or its clips were re-linked after the video was re-analyzed. Load it again.

422.description: Invalid edit list, including checks against the video: a rally_id that isn't one of its rallies, or times past its end. Errors have the usual `loc`, e.g. ["body", "edit", "clips", 2, "trim_end"]

delete.description: Delete a reel. The video and its rallies are not affected.

post.description:
Test fixture: finish a video as the worker would, with these rallies (and
optionally a shuttle trajectory), without running the ML pipeline. Goes through
crud.finish_video like a real worker, so reel clips are re-linked the same way.

corners.title: Corners
corners.description: Fractions of width/height, order: far-left, far-right, near-right, near-left. 0-1 is inside the frame; -0.3 to 1.3 is accepted (see court_out_of_frame on the video).

ErrorWithCode.title: ErrorWithCode
ErrorWithCode.description: {"detail": "...", "code": "..."}: detail is for people, code for the app.

enum: Processing kept stopping on this video
Something went wrong while processing this video
FailureReason.title: FailureReason
FailureReason.description:
Why a video failed, in words for the user (Video.failure_reason). The technical
details go to Video.error, which stays internal (it can contain server paths).
An enum so the frontend's generated types list every possible value.

oldest_queued_seconds.title: Oldest Queued Seconds
oldest_queued_seconds.description: How long the oldest queued video has waited (since it was queued or re-queued); null when nothing is queued

PrivateTrajectory.title: PrivateTrajectory
PrivateTrajectory.description: The worker's trajectory file contents (see app/trajectory.py).

rally_id.title: Rally Id
rally_id.description: The rally this clip came from. null: not tied to a rally (its rally disappeared when the video was re-analyzed)

restored_gaps.title: Restored Gaps
restored_gaps.description: Breaks between rallies shown again in cut view

ReelEdit.title: ReelEdit
ReelEdit.description:
The edit list, stored as JSON. `version` lets the format change later:
old versions get upgraded when read, so stored reels never need rewriting.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: The reel's updated_at as you loaded it. If it was saved elsewhere since then, the save is refused (409, code reel_changed)

ReelUpdate.title: ReelUpdate
ReelUpdate.description: Full replace of the title and edit list.

frame.title: Frame
frame.description: Frame index; the frame is at frame / fps seconds

t.title: T
t.description: Seconds in the original video (frame / fps)

x.title: X
x.description: Fraction of the frame width; null if not seen

y.title: Y
y.description: Fraction of the frame height; null if not seen

points.title: Points
points.description: Every frame between start and end, in order

failure_reason.description: Why it failed, for the user (only when status is 'failed')

play_seconds.title: Play Seconds
play_seconds.description: Total rally time in seconds (sum of rally durations): the match without the breaks

court_out_of_frame.title: Court Out Of Frame
court_out_of_frame.description:
Warning, not an error: part of the court is well outside the video, so
results may be less accurate. The app should tell the user and let them
decide. Computed here so the web and mobile apps can't disagree.
